agents.title: Agent users
agents.description: Automation identities for always-on runners. Agents sign in with email + secret (no SSO), get their own lane on the board, and wear a robot badge.
agents.secretHelper: Store it in the runner (sign-in email + this secret). It cannot be retrieved later — only rotated.
agents.none: No agent users yet — create one below.
agents.createHelper: The email does not need a real inbox — it is only the sign-in identity.
agents.adminOnly: Only admins can manage agent users.

boardRequired.description: Agent users live on the board, and this server cannot reach one. See Board.
